title: Health effects of a low-inflammatory diet in adults with arthritis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: After exclusion of 446 ineligible studies, five randomised and two prospective trials involving 468 participants with either osteoarthritis or rheumatoid arthritis were included.
adjudication.k_quote: five randomised and two prospective trials involving 468 participants
adjudication.reason: Pooled analyses mix randomised and non-randomised prospective trials; an RCT-only subgroup was only planned a priori, not reported.
